concept.title: Fluid Penetration
concept.shortdesc: Always use a board or cardboard when checking for a leak. Escaping fluid under pressure,

conbody.p: Always use a board or cardboard when checking for a leak. Escaping fluid under pressure, even a pin- hole size leak, can penetrate body tissue, causing serious injury, and possible death. If fluid is injected into your skin, it must be treated by a doctor familiar with this type of injury immediately.
